body:
Founder real-time ask. One-click composition of two existing primitives (Door + LevelExit centered on the same wall) in the Selected Cube inspector -- no new server-side type needed (widgets structurally can't own level_exits). New TestExport_CarriesDrexit verifies the exact round-trip shape. Also fixed a pre-existing goldenband.ts tsc build break blocking all frontend builds. IDUNA b2391b0, deployed to production (health check green).

title: DREXIT: door-that-is-also-an-exit, first-class in the SHANKPIT level editor
